translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Wiac sasawa nemmekecde

KEBU eriendzong memini, hallelu Yac. Anutunina yegec heimima dengereni, imoc wiac gombunga yombong. Ye ubangerec anemmeandeac amma ye sesehema yegec heimini, imoc ubangerehagoc nga faka imoc ngereede.
Ngic yeneng Israe arenggac ngicngac bic ukuyunugec. Nga KEBUNGO Yerusareng taong ine monggoc mema megboriu yeni monggoc kpedzucyunuma hoangyunuude.
Ngicngac herenginau ebic mema manganeyombonggeu yeng mengereyunuma kubecngina sangohoude.
Yeng asomeng kpetengina meserima kpacngina tembuc tembuc kparude.
KEBUNINA ye damu damuyagoc nga ye kuha engena yombong. Ngic mongngo yeac negen negentegecac kpetea naric mi meude, kpac.
Ngic yeneng ngicngac ogofocngina memayunugec KEBUNGO monggoc miacyunuma nanggeyunuude. Nga ngic Anutu ngadehema mangana megecdeac ayemmeande, yeni ine meyunuma bangecfu ukuyunuude.
KEBU ubangerecac yegec heimima Anutuninaac gita kpema imocngo udumeng gombunga memini.
Yeng kurumenga kurumenga hoengngo kperacyunuma kia faiu bangecfu mama fagannu kpindzing meficgeu ereude.
Yeng yang hania hania yakangina meficgeyemmeude. Neng yeneac medacngina yakaac derecgegec yeng yaka yemmeude.
Yeng becosi kuhagoc henu wiac engena mi ande nga ngic kuhagoc ye haningo sing herea tiu ye imoc henu wiac engena mi ande.

Ngicngac ye eweheiheigoc hoangeandae, yeng yenemma nengenu ngereeude. Yeng yoac dedzege amma imoc modarude. Nga ngicngac yeneng imocac negensima fora fingerudeac tomai kecandae, ye yeneac negenu ngereeu sogaiude.
O Yerusareng, ge KEBU yoyomo heimina. Siong, ge Anutuga yaiyo kpemibesena.
Ye taongga oda mengerema naguyaac aieng meseriu seria monggoc nanude. Yeng amaga manau medacfocga kenecyunuude.
Ye bangecgau ma faima ngicngacfocga onggongngunuu ruaegoc kecgecde. Ye wit semeng gombunga yombong meficgengemmeu negebec anggecde.
Ye dederecgeyoara bangecfu sueu imocngo bic yombong nedzima haude.
Ye nomang sueu imoc rama dzoea, ifi isoc amma bangecfu maude. Ye nomang bangecfu haudeac deu imocngo hama isoc bangec semeude.
Ye nomanggbomea minginango nomanggbomea imoc wiac kotaha isoc ukuu mau mongngo yeac nomang imohai serima naric mi nanude.
Ye nomanggbomea yoac edeyunuu yeni sisingaima doku monggoc anggecde. Ye firang minginango firang sueu bangec fifiranggeu doku dzuamagoc hakecgecde.
Ye yoara Yakobo mekperagimiu sing nga dederecgeyoara imoc Israe areng mekperagiyemmeec.
Ye bangec areng goa yeni faka ifia mong mi ayemmeec. Yeneng yeac dederecgeyoac mi negendae, kpac. KEBU eriendzong memini, hallelu Yac.
